metadata.title: Elementary Vocabulary & Spelling Curriculum (Grades 1-6)
metadata.description: Standard vocabulary and spelling words taught in elementary education (based on Dolch, Fry, Marzano Academic Vocabulary, and Common Core ELA standards), grouped by grade level and difficulty tier.

levels.level_1: (Easy) Foundational sight words, simple phonics patterns, and high-frequency everyday words.
levels.level_2: (Medium) Grade-level standard vocabulary, multisyllabic words, irregular vowel patterns, and descriptive terms.
levels.level_3: (Challenging) Advanced academic vocabulary, tier-2 words, Latin/Greek roots, and complex spelling patterns.
